test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a programme that translates each instruction of high-level language and executes it before passing on to the next instruction?
solution:
The correct answer is **Interpreter**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Interpreter** translates high-level programming language into machine language, line by line.
 
• It executes each instruction before moving to the next, without converting the entire source code into machine code at once.
 
• This allows for immediate error detection after each line, making debugging easier for developers.</li&
